summary.text: Keith Bell is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 4 who took office on January 8, 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Keith Bell earned an undergraduate degree from Dallas Baptist University.
He founded an electrical contracting business in 1983.
Bell's committee assignments in the 2023-2024 legislative session were Environmental Regulation, Land & Resource Management and Local & Consent Calendars.
In 2021-2022 he was vice chair of the Criminal Jurisprudence Committee and also served on Public Education.
